title: Been Tracking Bitcoin and Solana Side by Side, Here’s What I’m Seeing
author: dvysrm
selftext:
I’ve been comparing **Bitcoin and Solana** on CallPutCrypto to see how their short-term setups differ.

BTC and SOL can move together, but their technical structure and volatility can look very different at the same time. That’s why I’m building individual analysis pages rather than treating the entire crypto market as one signal.

CallPutCrypto combines **live Binance market data, technical indicators, multi-timeframe analysis, support and resistance, relevant crypto news and AI-generated market signals** for each asset.

For algo traders and discretionary traders, the idea is to quickly compare assets and see where the stronger technical setup might be developing.

I’m still actively developing the platform, so I’m continuously improving the screening logic, adding assets and refining the AI analysis.

**Bitcoin analysis:** [https://callputcrypto.com/crypto/bitcoin](https://callputcrypto.com/crypto/bitcoin)

**Solana analysis:** [https://callputcrypto.com/crypto/solana](https://callputcrypto.com/crypto/solana)
